analogy.rationale: Retinoid receptors (RAR/RXR) are nuclear receptors that heterodimerize with other nuclear receptors such as VDR, PPAR, LXR, and FXR, so agonists of these classes can share overlapping transcriptional programs; however, expression of RARs/RXRs is low in several of these cell lines, so the overall response is expected to be weak.
